finding: The test name test_st_0372_finding_format_names_the_seven_tags_for_next_id says seven tags, but the test checks the nine tags of PRODUCERS[FINDING_FORMAT], including ARCH and QA from DEC-25. Rename it to ..._names_the_nine_tags_for_next_id, or to ..._names_every_tag_for_next_id so the name survives the next added tag.
why_this_severity: The test checks all nine tags, so it does its job (no to fails_purpose); a reader who trusts the name looks for two missing tags and loses time (raises_cost).
